name: Miku's Modules +
author: dydymiku_
description: A 3D Hatsune Miku Skin Pack that has a great goal: bringing all the Project Diva modules back into Legacy Console Edition, made solo by an autistic lover of Hatsune Miku. Made in France :)
extended_description: Special thanks for Deca_dent for the OG 3D Miku model and Sails for the encouragement along with the entire community, without this, the entire project wouldn't be possible. Long live Hatsune Miku! ^^
